title: Choosing a material for a use
misconception: 1D-M1: chooses by colour or looks, not by properties
voice: Microsoft Zira Desktop (stand-in until the voice-over artist records)

pages.say: When you choose a material, think about the job it must do.
A roof must keep rain out, so it needs a waterproof material.
Metal roofing sheets are waterproof and strong.
A cooking pot must not melt or burn on the fire. Aluminium is a good choice.
Its handle may be wood or plastic, so it does not get too hot to hold.
A bright colour may look nice, but it does not make the pot cook well.
Choose a material because of its properties, not only how it looks.
Now it is your turn. Choose a material and say why.
